snippet.title: How Kenya’s Biggest FRAUDSTER Met His End
snippet.description:
He lived online like a king… but died in the forest like prey.

Frank Obegi flaunted first-class flights, champagne bottles, and the perfect influencer lifestyle. But behind the filters was a broke man begging his mother for 70 shillings — just a day before he vanished.

Then… bodies started turning up. Mutilated. Dumped. Unrecognizable.

This is not just the story of a scammer.

It’s the story of a *crypto-fueled rise*, a *blood-soaked betrayal*, and a murder mystery that remains **unsolved** to this day.

In this deep-dive true crime documentary, we expose:
* The illusion of wealth on social media
* The million-shilling scams that funded it
* The brutal fate that awaited the so-called “Kasarani Four”
* And the disturbing political ties behind it all

Was Frank Obegi a victim… or a villain in a bigger game?

⚠️ This is the dark side of clout, crypto, and Kenya’s influencer underworld.
And someone out there still knows the truth.

Subscribe for weekly documentary deep-dives into fraud, deception, digital crime and the hidden stories behind the headlines.

snippet.title: Blake Lively's Biggest Problem Isn't Justin Baldoni Anymore
snippet.description:
A newly unsealed court document filed May 1, 2026 shows a Sony marketing president texting her boss saying Blake Lively asked them to destroy the dailies from the It Ends With Us set and contact all vendors to delete their copies with proof of deletion required. Her exact words: first time I have ever been asked to do this in a movie with no nudity. But here is where it gets significant. In her deposition Blake Lively was asked directly whether she made that request or whether anyone made it on her behalf. She said no to both questions. That is a direct contradiction between sworn deposition testimony and a document now sitting in the court record. We also break down a second document showing Ryan Reynolds and Warren Zavala discussing seventeen days earlier that they had to assume Wayfarer had production evidence they planned to use against Blake. Two and a half weeks after that conversation Blake allegedly asked Sony to destroy the footage. With trial starting May 18, 2026, this is the document Blake Lively is going to have to explain under oath.
